10 Reasons I Love You 🌹

1. Your laugh is the most beautiful sound in my world — and also the reason I do dumb things just to hear it again.
2. You are annoyingly honest with me, and somehow that's my favourite thing about you.
3. The way you rest your head on my shoulder like you own the place. You do.
4. You eat more donuts than me and still look like that. It's unfair and I love it.
5. You make every boring car ride feel like an adventure.
6. You call me Nemo like I'm a lost fish, and I've never felt more found.
7. Your eyes — one look and my whole brain shuts down.
8. You argue with me and somehow still make me fall more in love mid-argument.
9. You make every place we go together feel like our place.
10. Simply — you, existing, being you. That's enough. That's everything.
